risk_note: RV2 ledger invariants (settlement-plan B2-04z, BR-FUND-19 ⑤⑧; S13). Adds two read-only single-SELECT files under db/invariants/ledger/ run by the existing daily-check runner: 05_union-receivable.sql (UNION_RECEIVABLE net per order against pending beneficiary credits, and the sum of beneficiary nets capped by the settlement base) and 08_invalid-still-credited.sql (orders INVALID, or with a succeeded INVALID_AFTER_SETTLE right, still CREDITED). Existing invariant files, superseded.json and the runner are unchanged (db/invariants is add-only). Cross-module read-only SQL is the single exception approved in S13. ⑥ stays with B2-05.
